title: Your first hour
text: SILVERWAKE teaches itself as you play. This page is the map for what comes after the tutorial: how a run is shaped, what to spend time on, and what the game will not tell you.

title: The tutorial
text: The tutorial Your first run opens with the tutorial. You wake in a sealed room with one glowing wall: fly into it and stay against it until it breaks. That is your first false wall, and the rest of the game hides secrets the same way. Behind it is your first boss, the Lodestone Scarab. Here nothing can bring you down, and the game stops to show you each tool as you need it: flying, dashing, the melee strike, your two guns, an ability, the wall-button items, slow-mo, the Parry, and floor marks. You will meet the Scarab again in sector 1 at full strength. Skipped a lesson? The tutorial stays on the start menu, and Controls covers every gesture. Settings also has a short How to play page.

title: The shape of a run
text: The shape of a run Fly through a sector. Ten sectors in all, each laid out anew every run. Doors seal while you fight and open when the room is clear. Dock at Lantern Docks. They save the run, refill your hull, top up your items, and are the only place to change your gear. See Docks, death and XP . Earn the Guardian. Its door stays barred until you have cleared 80% of the sector's fights or beaten 2 of its hidden bosses. Silence the Guardian. Each one opens the next sector for good, and some also open a new gun. Rooms you clear stay clear, even after a death or a reload, so a fall never undoes your progress through a sector.

title: Good first habits
text: Good first habits Keep the boss in front of you. Your gun fires where you are facing, and you face where you drag. There is no auto-aim beyond a tiny bend on near misses (the Wisp Seeker is the one exception). Watch for the warning, then move. Every attack shows itself first, by a pose or a mark on the floor. See Reading attacks . Use your items. The next dock tops them up to a small kit, so a Missile saved for later is often a Missile wasted. Press on the walls. In sectors 1 to 4, false walls glow while shut. Finding them early teaches you where to look later, when nothing marks them. Visit the skill tree between runs. XP buys permanent skills , and it is the only currency in the game.

title: What is free
text: What is free The tutorial and sectors 1 to 3 are free, with their Guardians and hidden lairs. One optional Full Game purchase opens sectors 4 to 10 and removes adverts. Adverts are opt-in, offered only on the results screen after a run. See the FAQ .

title: Controls
text: You fly with one thumb. The ship shoots by itself, so your whole job is where to be and which way to face. A small sketch of how the Vanguard handles, against a training bell. It is not the game itself. Start Drag to fly and aim Quick tap to dash Tap toward the bell, up close, to strike Two fingers together to parry With a mouse: drag to fly, click to dash or strike, right-click to parry. With keys: arrows or WASD to fly, Space to dash or strike, P to parry. Your gun fires by itself.

title: Every gesture
text: Every gesture Do this What happens Drag anywhere Fly that way and face that way. The drag can start anywhere on screen. A slow drag moves you one to one, a quick one up to twice as far, and the ship stops where your finger stops or lifts. Quick tap Dash. You are untouchable for a moment, so a dash can pass through bullets. Tap toward a close enemy Melee strike: dart in, hit with an explosion, spring back unhurt. It reaches about 64 px, the width of four floor tiles. Two fingers, tapped together Parry. It swings all round you and cuts every bullet near you. The Parry wall button does the same. Three fingers, tapped together Your quick ability: slow-mo by default. Pick another at any Lantern Dock. Hold a second finger while flying Aim separately. That finger holds your heading where it landed, then points the ship by its angle from there, so you can shoot back while retreating. Switch button Swap between your two guns. Other wall buttons Use an item or ability at once, with no freeze. Pause icon, top right The map, your run's numbers, Settings, Skills and Quit. Quit saves the run. Two thumbs held together resume.

title: How aiming works
text: How aiming works You aim by the way you are flying. In drag mode, the heading is the line through the last 5 mm of your finger's path, exact at any angle and steady through a shaky hand. To aim without travelling far, make a very short drag in the direction you want. A small aim assist bends a shot that would just miss by at most 8.4 degrees. It never seeks, and it never turns the ship. The Wisp Seeker is the exception: it aims itself at enemies within 80 px. Practise this: fly in a slow arc around a boss. You stay moving, which dodges aimed fire, and your nose stays near the target, which keeps you shooting.

title: What is on screen
text: What is on screen Top left: your hull plates, one per hit, and the picture of each gun you carry. Top wall: the room's wave count or goal, or a boss's name and health. Bottom wall: your wall buttons. They can move up the left or right wall in Settings. Round the ship: the Parry's recharge ring, and a dashed lilac ring further out for the melee strike.

title: Changing the controls
text: Changing the controls Setting What it changes Stick movement A stick under your thumb, not drag Steer anywhere The stick hides and follows your thumb Drag speed How far the Vanguard flies for your finger Sensitivity Higher: the Vanguard flies further for less thumb travel Tap away from enemies A tap away from enemies: Dash, or Lunge to strike what you pass Stick side Buttons and Pause take the other side Wall buttons Where the ability buttons sit: along the bottom wall, or up the left or right wall Button order Tap a button, then another, to swap them; 1 sits at the corner. Grey ones you have not had in a run yet Action buttons Dash, Bomb, Slow-mo and Halo on screen Mini-map Faint, on the arena floor, top left Vibration A buzz when you are hit

title: Reading attacks
text: Everything that hurts you warns you first. Bosses never show where their own body will move, but they do show every attack. Learning those warnings is the game.

title: What can hit you
text: What can hit you Only a small area at your chest takes damage. Bullets that clip your helmet, arms or blaster do nothing, so you have more room than it looks. This hit area is the same in every armour. You start with 6 hull plates, and each hit costs one. After a hit you have 2 seconds of safety, shown by the ship blinking. Touching a boss's body counts as a hit, so fight from a distance and dash through only when you must.

title: The kinds of attack
text: The kinds of attack You see What to do A fan of shots It is aimed at you when it fires. Slip between two shots, or move across the fan rather than away from it. A ring with an opening Fly through the gap. Running away only delays it, because the ring keeps growing. Seeking shots They curve after you for a moment and then fizzle. Fly in one wide arc until they run out. A glowing mark on the floor It bursts when it fills. Step out in time. A Parry does not help here. A marked line A beam or lash will follow that line. Leave it before the strike. Beams go through a Parry too. Walls of sound or bullets Look for the gap. If there is none, dash through.

title: Your escape tools, weakest danger first
text: Your escape tools, weakest danger first Moving. It costs nothing, so make it your first answer. Dash. Untouchable for a moment. The recharge is short, but a dash into a bad spot still hurts. Parry (4 s recharge). Cuts every bullet within 34 px, big ones included, sends them back at the nearest enemy and knocks enemies away. Beams and floor marks still hurt. Slow-mo. Every enemy and enemy bullet crawls for 2.5 seconds while you keep full speed. You carry few charges, so save it for the moment you are boxed in. Ward, Bubble or Halo. A short time of safety. See Items and abilities for what each one blocks. Bomb. Clears the bullets around you and hurts what is near. Bombs are scarce.

title: Graze for rewards
text: Graze for rewards Let shots pass close without touching you and a meter by your hull fills. A full meter gives a slow-mo charge, or a few seconds of keen shots if your charges are already full. Taking a hit empties it. You will not need this early on, but it turns good dodging into extra slow-mo later.

title: Learning a boss
text: Learning a boss When you fall, the death screen names what destroyed you. Look that attack up on the Bosses page. Survive an attack once and its card opens in the game. Bosses change in stages as they lose health, with new attacks at each stage. You can fight any boss you have beaten again in Practice, with no risk to your run. Struggling? Gentle mode makes fights kinder from your next run, and High-contrast threats makes enemy bullets stand out. Neither one is a penalty.

title: Guns
text: You carry two guns at a time, swap with the Switch button, and can change either one free at any Lantern Dock. No gun uses ammunition.

title: How to fly each one
text: How to fly each one

title: Silver Needle
text: Silver Needle Your all-rounder and every run's first gun. It reaches the whole room, so hold your distance and keep the target in front of you.

title: Wisp Seeker
text: Wisp Seeker It aims itself at enemies within 80 px and its wisps home, so you can fly purely for safety. The price is the lowest damage in the game and a short reach: stay close, and pair it with something that hits hard.

title: Ricochet Shard
text: Ricochet Shard Two shards in a narrow V that bounce off walls and obstacles up to twice. Use the walls: a bounce reaches enemies behind cover. Its travel is short, 150 px in all.

title: Scattergun
text: Scattergun Five pellets, enormous damage, and only 72 px of reach. Fly in, unload, and fly out. Beginners should carry it second, beside a long-range gun.

title: Psalm Lance
text: Psalm Lance A steady ray that climbs from 1x to 3x damage if it stays on one enemy for 1.5 seconds. Turning sharply resets it, so it rewards smooth arcs around a single big target. Superb against bosses.

title: Thurible Mortar
text: Thurible Mortar It lobs a shell over bullets, enemies and small obstacles to land 112 px ahead, and nothing closer than the landing is hit. Keep that distance deliberately, and aim at crowds.

title: Reliquary Bolt
text: Reliquary Bolt A slow bolt that sticks, then bursts half a second later for most of its damage. Stick it in the middle of a group, or in a wall beside a corner.

title: Ossuary Rail
text: Ossuary Rail It charges only while your heading holds. Line up, hold still in direction for a full second, and it fires through every enemy to the wall. The steadiest hand wins; a sharp turn starts it over.

title: Grave Lanterns
text: Grave Lanterns It drops mines behind you as you move, with no aiming at all. Fly in loops and let enemies chase you across them. Up to six lie at once for six seconds each.

title: Candle Bellows
text: Candle Bellows A short cone of flame that passes through everything it touches and leaves burning ground. Stay within 56 px, which means taking real risks for very high damage.

title: Rose Prism
text: Rose Prism A shot that splits on its first hit into a fan of five pieces flying onward. Weak against a lone boss and excellent in a crowd, so aim for the enemy at the front.

title: Good pairs
text: Good pairs Some pairs work together on their own. These bonuses are always on while you carry both guns: Wisp Seeker with Silver Needle: needles hit marked enemies harder. Any two guns: the first shot after a swap hits harder. Ricochet Shard with Scattergun: the Scattergun's pellets bounce once. The Loadout screen also offers ready-made builds, a good way to try a style without thinking it through first: Build What it does Vanguard The usual start: Needle and Scattergun, the Vigil Blade, the Lantern Plate. Skirmisher Fast and close: Ricochet and Scattergun, the Twin Censers, the light Pilgrim Weave. Bulwark Slow and hard to break: the Scattergun up close while the Seeker finds the rest, the Bell Hammer, the Bastion Plate. Hunter Mark and pierce: the Seeker marks for the Needle (Hunter's Mark), the Pilgrim Spear primes piercing shots; the Pilgrim Weave. Thornwright Splinters: the Rose Prism's fans and the Ricochet's bounces, the Vigil Blade, the Lantern Plate. Pyre Burn them: the Candle Bellows and the Rose Prism, the Twin Censers, the Bastion Plate. Bombard Bursts from afar: the Thurible Mortar and the Reliquary Bolt, the Bell Hammer, the Bastion Plate. Dockwatch Hesk's watch: Grave Lanterns behind you, the Scattergun ahead, the Bell Hammer, the Warden Mail. Chorister Hold steady: the Psalm Lance and the Ossuary Rail, the Pilgrim Spear, the Horologe Harness. Mourner Wren's lance and Sorrel's candle: the Psalm Lance and the Candle Bellows, the Twin Censers, the Vigil Shroud.

title: Weapon forms
text: Weapon forms Bring down three Guardians with a gun in your hand and it opens a second form, free to switch at any dock: Silver Lance (Silver Needle): slower, heavier needles that pass through two enemies. Moth Swarm (Wisp Seeker): three small wisps a volley. Prism Shard (Ricochet Shard): one hard shard that bounces four times and flies farther. Slug (Scattergun): one heavy slug that reaches farther and passes through an enemy. Requiem Lance (Psalm Lance): a longer beam whose focus builds slower but climbs to 4x. Censer Barrage (Thurible Mortar): smaller shells twice as often, landing closer. Martyr Bolt (Reliquary Bolt): a longer fuse and a far bigger burst. Bone Choir (Ossuary Rail): a quick, lighter line that forgives a little turning. Corpse Candles (Grave Lanterns): more, smaller lanterns that wake from farther. Votive Torch (Candle Bellows): one long tongue of flame that leaves fire more often. Lancet Window (Rose Prism): a heavier shot whose three pieces fly straighter and farther.

title: Modifiers
text: Modifiers Modifiers change whichever gun is in your hand. You hold two at most. Once a sector, a dock offers one free modifier from a choice of two. Taking a third replaces one you hold. Some cannot be held together, as the last column shows. Modifier Effect Not with Forked Two shots at a slight angle, each 60% as strong. The Scattergun doubles its pellets instead. Echoing Piercing Each shot passes through one more enemy. None Returning Spark Shots bounce twice more, and each bounce bursts for 60% damage, at 85% strength. Hollow Seeking Shots fired close to your target turn gently toward it, at 80% strength. None Far Calling Shots fly 20% faster and last 10% longer, so they reach further. Best on short-range guns. None Quickened Fires 20% faster, each shot 10% weaker. Weighty Weighty Shots hit 25% harder, firing 15% slower. Quickened Merciful 25% more damage to anything under a quarter of its health, bosses included. None Echoing A weaker second shot follows each shot, at 35% strength. Forked Hushed Hits slow ordinary enemies' movement by 15% for a moment. None Hollow Shots pass the room's small obstacles, at 90% strength. Returning Spark Steady Narrows the Scattergun's spread to 65%, and adds 5% damage to every gun. None

title: Status combos
text: Status combos Some weapons and modifiers leave Frost, Burn or a Mark on enemies. Two different effects on one enemy set off a combo: Steam: Frost meets Burn; a burst of steam round the enemy, and both end. Pyre: Burn meets Mark; a flare on the enemy, and its fire spreads to those beside it. Brittle: Frost meets Mark; the mark hurts even more while the enemy stays slowed.

title: Melee and the Parry
text: A melee weapon always sits beside your guns. Striking leaves you unhurt, so it is safer than it looks.

title: The strike
text: The strike Tap toward an enemy within about 64 px. The Vanguard darts in, hits with an explosion, and springs back. Any other tap dashes instead. A dashed lilac ring round the ship shows the strike recharging. Change your melee weapon at any Lantern Dock. Weapon Damage Recharge Blast Character Vigil Blade 9 1.2 s 14 px A plasma cut and a small burst; ordinary bullets round the strike are cut Bell Hammer 16 2.2 s 30 px A big tolling blast that knocks every ordinary enemy in it away Pilgrim Spear 11 1.5 s 10 px It darts farther and strikes every enemy along the way Twin Censers 3.5 × 2 0.9 s 12 px Two quick ember bursts a strike, ready again almost at once When to use it: after a boss finishes an attack and sits close, or to finish a weak enemy that is pressing you. Because you spring back out, a strike is also a way of leaving. In Settings, Tap away from enemies can turn the dash into a Lunge that strikes whatever it passes, at reduced damage.

title: The Parry
text: The Parry Tap two fingers together, or the Parry wall button. It works with any weapon and any armour. It cuts every enemy bullet within 34 px, big ones too, and sends them back at the nearest enemy. It knocks enemies back. It recharges in 4 seconds, shown by a ring round the ship. It does not stop beams or floor marks. Timing it The swing lasts a moment, so wait until bullets are close and bunched. Parry a whole wave as it reaches you rather than the first bullet of it. Against a ring with no safe gap, a Parry makes your own gap. Hard to hit two fingers mid-fight? Use the wall button. You can also move it, with the others, in Settings under Button order.

title: Items and abilities
text: Wall buttons fire at once with no freeze. Items are used up; abilities recharge. After you use one, all of them wait 0.6 seconds, shown by the buttons dimming, though the Parry and Switch never wait.

title: Items
text: Items Items drop from enemies and cleared rooms. You carry at most 2 of each, and every dock tops up your Missiles, Mines and Wards to 1 each. Bosses do not refund what you spent. Item What it does Missile A homing dart that seeks the nearest foe and bursts on impact (30 damage, 12 splash). Mine Sets a mine where you are. Enemy bullets pass over it; the first enemy that touches it sets it off with a Bomb's blast. Not set off when you leave the room, it comes back to you. Ward Nothing can hurt you for 2.5 seconds. Bomb A shockwave around you. It kills small foes, hurts big ones and throws enemy bullets away harmlessly. 5 s cooldown; you get 2 at the start of every sector and rarely find more (max 3). Giga Bomb A blast that fills the room. Ordinary enemies are destroyed, elites and room leads lose a third of their health, bosses a small share, and every enemy bullet is thrown away harmlessly. Slow-mo charge For 2.5 s every enemy and enemy bullet crawls while you move at full speed. Charges are rare: you start with 1 (max 3). The Giga Bomb is rare. None appear before sector 4, and at most one a sector. It takes 8% of a boss's full health and 35% of an elite's, and ends every other enemy in the room.

title: Abilities
text: Abilities Each ability you own gets its own wall button. Abilities refuse to fire in an empty room, so you cannot waste one by accident. Ability How you get it Lasts Recharge What it does Bubble A reward from bosses and cleared rooms 3 s 25 s Nothing can hurt you, and enemy bullets touching the bubble burst. Wingmen A reward from bosses and cleared rooms 10 s 30 s Two small jets circle you, fire at the nearest foe and soak up bullets as decoys. Halo A skill, 160 XP 2.5 s 20 s Immune to enemy bullets and beams. Bodies, mines, boss rings and floor hazards still hurt.

title: The three-finger tap
text: The three-finger tap A three-finger tap uses your quick ability: slow-mo by default. At any Lantern Dock you can set it to any wall button. Pick what you reach for in a panic.

title: Slow-mo
text: Slow-mo Every enemy and enemy bullet drops to 35% speed for 2.5 seconds while you keep moving at full speed. You start a run with 1 charge and can hold 3. Grazing and some skills give more.

title: Armour
text: Armour changes your speed and hull, and some pieces add a special rule. Change it at the Loadout or any Lantern Dock. Your hit area is the same in all of them. Armour Hull Speed Rule How you get it Lantern Plate Standard Standard None Free from the start Pilgrim Weave −1 plate +15% None Free from the start Bastion Plate +2 plates −15% None Free from the start Warden Mail −1 plate −5% Parries an ordinary bullet about to hit by itself, every 4 s From Hesk, at the end of their story Vigil Shroud Standard Standard Half a second more safety after a hit From Sorrel, at the end of their story Horologe Harness Standard Standard Slow-mo lasts 0.6 s longer and recharges a quarter faster From Ambrel, at the end of their story Wright-Forged Plate +1 plate −10% Wards off the first hit in each room entered From Corwin, at the end of their story Starlight Plate Standard Standard A look only: the Lantern Plate's numbers Cosmetic pack Verdant Weave −1 plate +15% A look only: the Pilgrim Weave's numbers Cosmetic pack Royal Bastion +2 plates −15% A look only: the Bastion Plate's numbers Cosmetic pack Which one first? Stay in the Lantern Plate until you know a sector. Then try the Pilgrim Weave if you keep running out of room to dodge, or the Bastion Plate if you keep dying with no time to read what hit you. Paid armours are looks only: each has the same numbers as a free one. No armour you can buy is stronger than one you can earn.

title: Skills
text: XP is the only currency in the game. Skills stay for every future run. Open the tree from the start menu, or from Pause during a run.

title: Earning XP
text: Earning XP You do this XP Kill an enemy 1 Kill an elite 4 Clear a room 3 Clear an ordinary fight without a hull hit 4 more Beat a Guardian 40 Beat a hidden boss 50 Trials pay extra for each better medal, and a Guardian beaten without a hull hit in its sector offers one more reward. See what a death does to your XP .

title: Docks, death and XP
text: Lantern Docks are glowing landing pads. Hover over one and the run is saved. Learn where they are, because you will wake at the last one after a fall.

title: What a dock does
text: What a dock does Saves the run and refills your hull. Tops up your kit: at least 1 each of Missile, Mine and Ward. Changes your gear: two guns, melee, armour, weapon form, and your three-finger ability. All free and all unlimited. Offers a free modifier, once a sector. Sends you elsewhere: from a dock, open Pause and tap a framed dock on the map to fly there.

title: When you fall
text: When you fall You wake at your last Lantern Dock. Rooms you cleared stay clear. The XP you had not yet banked stays where you fell: fly back to it and it is yours again. Fall a second time before reaching it and it is lost. Fall in a Guardian's room and you wake outside it, at its Mooring. You decide when to go back in, and retrying costs nothing.

title: Moorings
text: Moorings The rest room before a Guardian is its Mooring. Reaching one opens that Guardian in the Boss Arena. Prepare there before you enter, and speak to anyone waiting there: the people you meet in Moorings hand over armours and guns as their stories go on. See NPCs .

title: The map
text: The map Open Pause to see the sector map. It shows the rooms you have visited, your ship blinking, and marks on doors for the goals beyond them. To see every sector you have visited, pinch out or tap the minus button. The Mini-map setting adds a faint small map to the room.

title: Saves
text: Saves You have three run slots. Quit saves the run and returns to the start menu; it never abandons it. Abandoning is on the start menu only, behind two confirmations, and banks the run's XP.

title: Rooms and goals
text: A room is rarely just "kill everything". The marks on a door tell you what is behind it, and the top wall tells you the rules once you are inside.

title: Room goals
text: Room goals Goal What to do Hunt An elite is marked. Bring it down and the rest scatter: the room clears. Pays a reward and XP. Hold out Foes keep coming. Survive until the toll ends: the room clears when the clock on the top wall runs out. Pays an item. Race Clear the room fast: the sooner it clears, the more XP it pays. The bar on the top wall shrinks as time passes. Thief A thief runs off with a reliquary toward the far door. Catch it before it escapes for a reward and XP. Crossing No foes here, but the room's dangers run quick. Cross to the reliquary pad and hover on it. Pays XP and an item. Reliquaries Three sealed reliquaries. Hover by one to break its seal: each starts its own wave and pays its own reward. Nests Nests on the walls keep sending foes. Shoot the nests down; the room clears with the last foe after them. Pays XP and an item. Wards Candles shield every foe while they burn. Shoot the candles out. Put out every one for a reward and XP. Motes Motes drift through the fight. Fly through them to catch them: each pays XP, all of them an item. Trial: melee only Your guns are silent for the whole fight. Tap toward a foe to strike it with your melee weapon; the Parry still works. Clear every wave for a reward and XP. Trial: no hit Take no hit through every wave. Keep it for a reward and XP. One hit breaks the trial: the room still clears, with no reward. Trial: before the bell Beat the bell: clear every wave before the clock runs out; the clock is on the top wall. In time: a reward and XP. Late: the trial breaks and the room just clears. Trial: parry Cut the set number of shots with the Parry before the last of the waves falls; the count is on the top wall. Done: a reward and XP. Trial: grounded No dash in this room, and take no more than one hit through every wave. Keep it for a reward and XP. Room rule: ricochet Enemy shots bounce once off the walls here. Watch the angles. Room rule: tempo A bell keeps time here: every attack and hazard starts on its beat. Listen for the tick and move between beats. Room rule: armoury A loaner gun for this fight. Your own gun is one tap of Switch away, and your guns come back when the room clears. Surprise: the mirror Something wears your shape and fires your own gun back at you. Bring it down for a reward and XP. Surprise: a memory A Guardian you have beaten returns as a memory, weaker than before. Bring it down for a reward and XP. Surprise: heavy shots Every enemy shot here is twice the size and slow. Weave between them and clear the room for a reward and XP. Surprise: the turning weight This room's weight turns: everything is pulled toward one wall, and the wall changes as the room turns. Clear it for a reward and XP.

title: Room leads
text: Room leads Most ordinary fights are led by one of the sector's two named leads: a bigger foe with a ring of runes at its feet, its name and health bar on the top wall, and three warned attacks of its own. Treat it as a small boss. Up to three helpers come with it, and the fight turns as it weakens.

title: Omens
text: Omens Almost every ordinary fight carries an omen, a condition that changes how the room plays. Each one announces itself as the fight begins. Later sectors may pair two. Here are all 56: Show every omen Gale Hall: the wind carries every shot. Fly upwind of them. Undertow: currents run across the floor. Ride them or cross them. Maelstrom: the whole room turns about its middle. A black star pulls at you and bends every shot. Black ice: your thrusters slide. A dash stops you dead. Bellows: jets blast across the room and blow the shots away. Lodestones pull and push, and turn at the change of their sign. Deep water: every shot slows the farther it flies. Bronze walls: touch one and it throws you back. Snow piles where nothing moves. Keep your roads open. This room's weight turns. Watch the walls. Lights out: only your lantern. Shoot the braziers to light them. In the shadows they lose you and fire where they last saw you. Spore mist hides them. Your path clears it. Candles are the only light. Their shots snuff them; you relight them. Darkness, but the lightning shows them. Glass phantoms: only the true one casts a shadow. Hall of mirrors: every shot bounces once. The east and west walls open into each other. Thorns close in with every wave. Clear them fast. Vines grow and stop every shot. Cut your lanes. Two rifts are joined: what enters one leaves the other. Shoot through the great lens: your shots grow, theirs dissolve. A glass screen splits the room. Break it or fight round it. Stopped clock: time slows while you hold still. The forge floor burns where you linger. Keep moving. Their shots wait for the bell. Move between the beats. Night and day: tough in the light, frail in the dark. The tide comes and goes. In the water every shot is slow. The room quickens until a wave falls. Hush: no guns here. Your blade and your parry are quick. Your shots hang in the air. Dash to loose them. A borrowed gun for this room: a borrowed gun. Grave harvest: grazing their shots feeds your gun. Thruster surge: dash freely. Your trail burns them. Your reflection fights beside you. Glass hull: every hit costs two plates; every shot hits twice as hard. A great bell hangs here. Ring it with your shots. Sluice gates: hover on a plate to flood that side. Sleeping sentinels. Hover beside one to wake it. Crystals burst into shards that cut everyone. Spore pods: burst them to slow everything in the cloud. A lantern waits. Carry it: its light weakens them. Bars ring the middle. Fly the track. Bars line the way. Run the gauntlet. The walls slide. Mind the grinding marks. The orrery's arms turn. Ride behind them. The roof gives way with every wave. Molten pours harden into walls. Lightning runs between the rods. Stay off the lines. A loose bell rolls through the room. The moon's beam sweeps the room. Ink creeps after you. Lead it through them. Pendulum blades swing. Cross between them. A ghost train runs these rails. Watch for its lamp. Where they fall, thorns bloom.

title: Room forms
text: Room forms An ordinary fight may be laid out in one of thirteen forms: moats, islands, naves, cells and rooms that change as the fight goes on. The ones to learn: Drops are floor to you, because you fly. They are walls to enemies that walk, and one knocked against the edge falls. Fliers and bullets cross freely. Cracked stone can be shot down, by you and by enemy fire, so cover does not last. Shifting rooms warn you with marks on the floor before they change.

title: Things in rooms
text: Things in rooms A bell on a post: strike it and the room's trap springs once. Use it on enemies. A chandelier: shoot it to drop it where it hangs. Censers: they blow up when shot and can hurt you too. Sleepers ("zz"): strike them first for a bonus. A falling reliquary: grab it within 8 seconds. A chest: from sector 2, one chest a sector may be a mimic. It has tells, and pays more when it falls. Enemy crossfire: shots that fly far enough hurt the enemies they meet.

title: Dares
text: Dares A plain fight may offer one optional dare on its top wall, paying an extra reward: Cut a set number of shots with the Parry. Graze a set number of shots. Land a set number of blade strikes. Down a set number of foes with blasts. Drop the chandelier on a foe. Strike a set number of sleepers before they wake.

title: In a cleared room
text: In a cleared room Offering altar: hover by it for a free gift. Bell of Defiance: makes your next fight harder, in exchange for double XP and a reward. Cursed reliquary (from sector 2): a reward and an item now, but any hull hit fells you until ten kills or a fall ends the curse. Vault: one side room a sector, behind a barred door. It opens with a Wardkey from the sector's elite, by arriving soon enough, or on a streak of twenty kills without a hull hit.

title: False walls and hidden bosses
text: False walls and hidden bosses False walls open only when you press against them. They stand off the middle of their side. In sectors 1 to 4 they glow. From sector 5 nothing marks them at all, and the Sector Complete banner counts the secrets you missed. Behind them wait hidden bosses and supply caches. Every sector holds several, and from sector 2 one of them is an echo lair where the previous sector's Guardian returns. They are optional, but beating 2 of them opens the Guardian's door early.

title: The Wakeful
text: The Wakeful Linger in a sector for seven minutes without resting at a dock and a toll warns you, then an untouchable hunter enters your fights. It drifts through walls and costs a hull plate on touch. Keep moving, or rest at a dock.

title: Bosses
text: Each attack below is written as the game's own attack card has it: what you see, then what to do. The numbers are from the game's data. Stages: a boss changes as its health falls, usually at about two-thirds and one-third. Each change has a name and brings new attacks.

title: The main road
text: The main road

title: The Lodestone Scarab
text: The Lodestone Scarab Bars the way in sector 1, Briarstorm Cloister. Health 760. Stages: The Shell Cracks → Its Furnace Laid Bare. Attack What you see and what to do Roll It scrapes the floor, curls into a boulder and rolls straight to the wall. Dash across its line, then hit its underside. Stones Three stones are pulled to it, then kicked along three paths. Stand between two paths. Shockwave It braces, then a ground ring spreads with a broad opening to one side of you. Move into the opening.

title: The Thorn Reliquary
text: The Thorn Reliquary Guardian of sector 1, Briarstorm Cloister. Health 940. Stages: The Heartwood Splits → Thorns Without End. Attack What you see and what to do Vine Lash An arm draws back and a line marks where it will lash. Leave the line before the strike. Root Crawl A root pod drops and crawls after you while the body fights on. Keep ahead of it; it climbs home soon. Root Eruption Marked bursts run from under it toward you in a chain. Step aside from the chain's line. Petal Bloom The heart opens and spins out petal spirals. Circle with the spin and slip between the arms. Hound Call Thorn hounds rush you. Shoot them down or dash through a lunge. Seekers Bright shots curve after you for two seconds, then fizzle. Keep flying in one wide arc and they run out.

title: The Last Lamplighter
text: The Last Lamplighter Guardian of sector 2, Drowned Scriptorium. Health 1050. Stages: Every Flame Burns Blue → He Is the Last Light. Attack What you see and what to do Snuff He reaches his pole to a lit lamp and puts it out; wax sprays from it into the room. Stand off the lamp's side. Hook He draws the pole back, then sweeps an arc of shots where you were; a second arc follows later. Slip through a gap. Flare He lifts his lantern and every lit lamp bursts a ring of wax. Fewer lamps lit, fewer rings. Lamp Beam A lamp's beam is marked across the room, then burns. Step out of the mark. Ember Moths Ember moths curve after you for a moment, then burn out. Keep flying in one wide arc.

title: The Bronze Watchman
text: The Bronze Watchman Guardian of sector 3, Hollow Belfry. Health 1000. Stages: The Quarters Strike → Eleven Fifty-Nine. Attack What you see and what to do The Clock's Hands The clock's hands turn over the floor and hurt to touch. Stay clear of the minute hand's sweep, or dash across it. Watchman's Call Its lantern flares, then bolts come at you in the chime's rhythm. Keep moving across them; late on, some lead you. The Hour Its hammer rises and the Hour Bell sends walls of sound down the room. Find each wall's gap, or dash through it. Escapement Its chest dial spins out arms of cogs that move and stop together. Slip between them while they stand still. Hammer Close by, it raises its hammer and sweeps the arc in front of it, marked first. Back off or get behind it. Pendulum The great pendulum drops at one side and swings across the room. Its bob and rod hurt: stay below or away. Eleven Fifty-Nine It turns its key: the minute hand races, then walls of sound with no gap. Leave the hand's circle; dash each wall.

title: The Corrupted Robo
text: The Corrupted Robo Guardian of sector 4, Frostveil Transit. Health 720. Stages: Its Plating Falls Away → The Core Runs Wild. Attack What you see and what to do Arm Throw The throwing arm pulls back and glows, then flies out and bursts shards. Sidestep the throw, then the shards. Rivet Fan The chest glows, then a fan of rivets, twice. Slip between two rivets. Stomp Ring The body lifts, then slams: a ring with one gap. Fly through the gap. Hound Call The antenna flashes and hounds arrive. Shoot them down or dash through a lunge. Seekers Bright shots curve after you for two seconds, then fizzle. Keep flying in one wide arc and they run out.

title: The Candle Parliament
text: The Candle Parliament Guardian of sector 5, Cinderheart Foundry. Health 880. Stages: The Wax Runs Red → One Flame for All. Attack What you see and what to do Crescent Vote The crescent faces you and spaced moths release one sparse fan. Slip between the flames. Procession Two columns form either side of where you were and fire along themselves. Keep to the lane between them. Unanimous Charge A spear forms far from you and its route through you is marked. Leave the route before the pass. Scattered Debate Groups of four fly to their points and pause; one in each fires a small fan at once. Slip between them.

title: The Griefwell
text: The Griefwell Guardian of sector 6, Fracture Observatory. Health 880. Stages: Grief Overflows → The Well Has No Floor. Attack What you see and what to do Inhale Motes appear in a ring and curve inward to orbit the core. Keep clear of their arcs while they fall in. Exhale The held motes facing you dissolve: a sure opening. Hold it; the rest fly outward. Orbit Pair Two satellites rise and make one orbit, shedding pellets later on. Stay off the orbit's circle. Translation It marks a station and darts there, harmless. Watch its black holes: they pull, and their cores hurt.

title: The Sepulchre King
text: The Sepulchre King Guardian of sector 7, Verdant Reliquary. Health 910. Stages: The Crown Burns Cold → The King Will Not Kneel. Attack What you see and what to do Arm Launch An arm pulls back and flies to where you were, landing with a gilded ring. Move at the pull-back and pass the ring's gap. Blade Sweep Three arcs are marked in turn and cut in that order. Stand in the arc already cut. Leg Charge A leg hovers off and charges you, re-aiming between charges. Dash across its path, not away from it. Vault Burst The chest vault opens and fires a fan, twice. Slip between two shots; stay close to the gap. Hound Call Royal hounds chase and lunge. Shoot them down or dash through a lunge. Seekers Bright shots curve after you for two seconds, then fizzle. Keep flying in one wide arc and they run out.

title: The Pale Interceptor
text: The Pale Interceptor Guardian of sector 8, Stormbreak Causeway. Health 760. Stages: Throttle Unbound → Engines Screaming. Attack What you see and what to do Lead Burst It locks a point ahead of your course and fires a burst there. Change course or stop as it locks. Attack Run Its whole route is marked edge to edge, then one fast pass. Leave the marked route. Flanking Arc It flies an arc round one corner, then fires a wide fan. Slip between the fan's shots. Brake Counter It brakes hard and sits exposed, then one precise shot. Move as it fires; hit it while it sits.

title: The Iron Pilgrim
text: The Iron Pilgrim Guardian of sector 9, Resonant Quarry. Health 860. Stages: Full Steam → The Furnace Bursts. Attack What you see and what to do Charge The train stops and the route ahead is marked, then the engine runs it. Leave the marked stretch. Mortar Three landing circles are marked, one on you. Leave the circles before the shells fall. Whistle Sound rings spread with wide openings, the first facing you. Take an opening; each ring's openings shift. Last Charge The short engine marks a long charge and brakes to a stop. Leave the mark, then punish the stop.

title: The Last Organ
text: The Last Organ Guardian of sector 10, Eclipse Basilica. Health 960. Stages: The Shutters Open → The Final Hymn. Attack What you see and what to do Bass Procession The bass pipes charge, then slow waves roll down the hall, each with one opening. Find the opening and move with it. Treble Needles Treble pipes flash one by one and each lights a floor column. The needles fall in that same order: leave the lit columns. Fugue Three floor lanes light one after another, starting with yours. The other three lanes always stay safe: move to one. Bellows Exhale The bellows swell, then one broad fan with three clear openings, one toward you. Hold an opening.

title: Hidden bosses
text: Hidden bosses Spoilers. Finding these is part of the game. Open one only when you want to. Show the 30 hidden bosses

title: The Eclipse Archon
text: The Eclipse Archon Beyond the last Guardian, in Eclipse Basilica. Health 1800. Stages: The Vessel Breaks → A Choir of One. Attack What you see and what to do Memory Spear A ring stops and three fragments stretch into a spear; a line locks where you were. Move sideways once it locks. Crescent Divide Two arcs of pellets close in from the side walls and stop short of a broad middle opening. Sit in the opening. Broken Halo Six large slow stones ring the body with one broad safe sector, never simply where you are. Find the gap and stay in it. Processional Rail The beast compresses in place, then races once on a curved run through where you were. Keep moving when it coils. Reliquary Roll Its plates fold into a wheel, then it rolls straight once to the wall and uncurls with its Core open. Step aside as it curls. Procession Arms Two arms leave for your flanks and each sweeps once from where it lands. Shoot an arm to break it for the stage. Twin Berth Collapse Two broad side lanes light with a safe channel between; they slam one after the other. Hold the middle channel. Choir Wingbeat Moth flames light along the wings; two pressure waves roll out with a large central opening. Fly into the opening. Glass Division The body splits into three lobes; one brightens and surges in a straight line, three times. Watch the bright one. Parliament Spear Twelve moths flare and pack into an arrowhead that dives once and returns. Sidestep as they pack; the body is open. Undertow Rise It dives and a shadow swims below; a marked circle fills, it breaches, and a ring follows with a wide gap. Leave the circle. Written Fugue Three routes are drawn, A, B, C, then fire in that order. Your spot is never on all three; move as each clears. Pipe Counterpoint Two of three pipe banks light; the dark one marks the broad safe region. Go to the dark side before they fire. Borrowed Phrase A route it already played is drawn again, then fires backwards after a full warning. Leave the old route. Footnote of the Past A box marks where you were a second ago, then a chord strikes it once. Do not drift back into the box. Open Core The Core brightens between attacks. Turn toward it: hits there do more. Long Opening After its last sequence the Core stays open longer. Spend everything on it. Eclipse Intercept It brightens in place, then makes one fast pass aimed ahead of your course with a three-shot burst. Change course as it brightens. Griefwell Slingshot Four slow shots bend once round the Core, stop, show their outward lines, then leave along them. Stand off the lines. Severed Wing A wing detaches to a marked flank and fires one shallow fan. Stay out of the fan; shooting the wing counts. Black-Star Exhale Motes gather toward the Core and hold while their outward lines show, then leave with broad openings. Pick an opening early. Choir Fan Six moth lights fan out toward you during its recovery. Slip between two lights. Return Wave The last route is drawn again and fires in reverse. Leave the rou

title: The Unwritten Atlas
text: The Unwritten Atlas Hidden in sector 2, Drowned Scriptorium. Health 1100. Stages: The Ink Runs Wild → The Clasp Breaks. Attack What you see and what to do Brushstroke A faint ink route curves through where you are; pellets follow it in a line. Leave the line. Stamp A rectangle is stamped where you were a moment ago. Keep moving and it misses. Gliders Paper gliders fold, each already pointing its way, and make one straight pass. Step out of their lines. Reposition The cover shuts and it glides elsewhere, harmless. Hit it once it reopens. Two Drawings A brushed route fires, then a stamp lands where you were. Leave the line, then keep moving.

title: The Borrowed Minute
text: The Borrowed Minute Hidden in sector 3, Hollow Belfry. Health 1050. Stages: Time Fractures → The Last Grains Fall. Attack What you see and what to do Row A sparse row of slow grains crosses the room; later the same route returns faintly in reverse. Pass between the grains. Sandfall Sand columns light one after another in order; a repeat replays them backwards. Stand in a column already fallen. Turn It turns over and moves to a new hover point, untouchable while turning. Reposition and wait. Pause A long exposed pause. Pour damage into the chambers or the neck.

title: The Glass Tide
text: The Glass Tide Hidden in sector 5, Cinderheart Foundry. Health 900. Stages: The Tide Divides → A Sea of Shards. Attack What you see and what to do Surge One body gathers itself and leans briefly, then surges to the wall, leaving puddles. Dash across its line and avoid the rings. Dome A body swells into a dome, then releases a sparse fan of droplets near you. Slip between the droplets. Split At a stage break the liquid flows together and divides into smaller bodies, harmless while it does. Spread your fire.

title: The Vesper Wyrm
text: The Vesper Wyrm Hidden in sector 9, Resonant Quarry. Health 1050. Stages: It Takes to the Sky → The Nave Burns. Attack What you see and what to do Sweeping Breath It rears back, throat glowing, then sweeps a stream of fire across the nave. Put a pillar between you, or slip behind the stream. Claw Rake Too close in front, it lifts a foreleg: three marked arcs cut in turn. Back off or dash through the one already spent. Tail Lash Behind it, the tail curls: a wide marked arc, then a ring of bone shards from the tip. Find the gap in the ring. Ember Spit Fireballs arc at and around you; each marked circle bursts into embers and burns a while. Leave the circles. Brood Call Ashen whelps answer its call. They circle you, glow before they spit and bite on touch. Thin them fast. Take Wing Its wings spread and it climbs: high above, its body cannot touch you, but its fire still can. Strafing Pass It leaves the room, then sweeps across it low and fast, burning patches behind it. Step off the marked patches. Fire Rain Circling above, it drops fireballs near you and across the nave. Keep moving between the marked circles. Dive It hovers, flashing red, then falls on where you were and rings out fire. Move as it flashes. Inferno Its jaws loose three streams of fire that turn round the room. Run with the gap, or shelter behind a pillar.

title: The Ossuary Widow
text: The Ossuary Widow Hidden in sector 7, Verdant Reliquary. Health 980. Stages: The Brood Wakes → The Last Thread. Attack What you see and what to do Web Shot She rears and throws balls of web at and around you. Each marked circle becomes a web on the floor that slows you; a dash tears free. Silk Fan Her spinnerets fan silk threads at where you were. Slip between the threads. Fang Lunge Too close, she flashes red and lunges: the bite's arc is marked where she stops. Get out of the arc. Brood She lays egg sacs that hatch into spiderlings. They dart at you in zigzags and bite. Keep away from the sacs and thin the brood fast. Ceiling Drop She climbs her thread out of reach, then hangs over you flashing red and drops, ringing out silk. Move as she flashes. Web Cage Strands are marked from her to the walls, then cut. Find the gap in the cage.

title: The Drowned Reflection
text: The Drowned Reflection Hidden in sector 8, Stormbreak Causeway. Health 900. Stages: The Mirror Cracks → It Looks Back. Attack What you see and what to do Ripple It flies where you flew a moment ago, mirrored, and echoes your gun down your old lines. It also rings the water with gapped rings. Grasping Hands Hands rise from the water where you were a moment ago. Each circle is marked; keep moving somewhere new. Undertow Drowned bearers rise from dark puddles and wade at you. Thin them before they reach you. Storm The beacons gather the storm: marked chains between them strike, and so does the water round the reflection. Leave the marked lines. Break the Surface Close by, it stops mirroring, flashes red and lunges: the strike's arc is marked where it stops. Look Back Its eyes burn white: for a while it follows you almost at once and its echoes come fast. Keep your lines short and turning.

title: The Undertow Queen
text: The Undertow Queen Hidden in sector 2, Drowned Scriptorium. Health 1050. Stages: The Tide Turns → The Queen Rises Ragged. Attack What you see and what to do Wingbeat Pressure waves spread off both wings with an opening toward you and one behind. Hold the opening. Pearl Fan A sparse fan of pearls from the mouth, in volleys. Slip between two pearls each time. Pearl Ring Pearls ring the body, then a second ring turned half a step. Pass each ring through its gap. Breach It sinks and its shadow swims to where you were; the zone is marked. Leave the mark before it breaches.

title: The Corrupted Raven
text: The Corrupted Raven Hidden in sector 3, Hollow Belfry. Health 800. Stages: The Storm Answers → Lightning in Its Bones. Attack What you see and what to do Feather Ring Feathers spin round it, then spiral outward. Stay out of the ring's reach and slip between the spiral's arms. Feather Fan One wing flares lit and fans feathers, then the other wing. Dodge once, then once more. Lightning Call Strike marks appear, one on you. Step off every mark before the lightning lands. Dive Its wings fold back, then it swoops to where you were. Move at the fold; its body hurts on touch. Seekers Bright shots curve after you for two seconds, then fizzle. Keep flying in one wide arc and they run out.

title: The Rook Mother
text: The Rook Mother Hidden in sector 3, Hollow Belfry. Health 800. Stages: The Bells Toll for You → She Sheds Her Black. Attack What you see and what to do Toll She beats her wings at a bell and it sends a ring of shots out with one gap. Meet the gap. Dive Her body flares, then she dives straight through where you were and sheds a fan of feathers. Keep moving. Moult She shakes her plumage and feathers fall in columns from the top, with one wide empty lane. Find the lane. Homing Feathers Her ruff of bells rings and feathers curve after you, then fall. Keep flying in one wide arc.

title: The Briar Hart
text: The Briar Hart Hidden in sector 1, Briarstorm Cloister. Health 900. Stages: Storm in the Crown → The Burning Rut. Attack What you see and what to do Thorn Spears It lowers its crown and flings a fan of thorn spears at you. They fly to the walls and stick there. Slip between them. Splitting Spears Every spear stuck in a wall splits into a half ring of thorns thrown back into the room. Stand away from the walls they stand in. Charge It paws the ground, flashing red, then runs at where you were until it hits a wall, briar growing where it ran. Move as it flashes. Stamp It rears and stamps: a ring of thorns with one gap, and briar springing up round it. Find the gap. Crown of Storms Its antlers call lightning onto marked circles near you, one after another. Keep moving out of each circle. Antler Whirl Too close, it spins: the ring its antlers sweep is marked. Get out of the ring (later it throws thorns as it spins).

title: The Inkwell Abbot
text: The Inkwell Abbot Hidden in sector 2, Drowned Scriptorium. Health 960. Stages: The Ink Rises → Unwritten. Attack What you see and what to do Sigils He writes sigils on the floor near you, each numbered in order. Nothing hurts yet: watch the numbers. Recitation He reads his sigils back in their order: each bursts into a ring of ink. Leave each one before its turn. Blot A lane right across the room through you is marked while ink seeps in from its ends, then floods. Leave the lane. Quill Flick His quill flicks fans of ink at you, two or three times. Later he aims where you are going. Slip between the drops. Inkpots His inkpots wheel round him and spit at you, again and again. Keep moving across their aim. Erase He sinks into his own ink and rises somewhere else. Later he leaves a ring of ink where he sank. Keep clear as he sinks.

title: The Carillon Twins
text: The Carillon Twins Hidden in sector 1, Briarstorm Cloister. Health 1000. Stages: Out of Tune → The Last Change. Attack What you see and what to do Peal They ring by turns: a ring of notes with one gap from each in turn. Find each ring's gap. Chime Both fling a fan of chimes at you from their two sides. Slip between the fans. Toll Each marks a lane down the room from where it stands, then strikes it. Leave both lanes. Skipping Rope They pull their rope taut and swing it round between them. The hot rope hurts: cross it as it passes, or dash. Changeover They spring across the room past each other, the rope taut between them. Keep clear of the line between them. Harmony Both ring together: two rings of notes crossing. Find where the rings leave room.

title: The Rime Conductor
text: The Rime Conductor Hidden in sector 4, Frostveil Transit. Health 1040. Stages: Frost on the Glass → Terminus. Attack What you see and what to do Whistle He sprays a fan of ice that stops dead and hangs in the air. Frozen shards still hurt: thread between them. Frost Ring A ring of flakes with one gap spreads out and freezes round him. Leave through the gap. Thaw Every frozen shard flies again: outward from him, later at you. Watch the hanging ice, not just him. Signal Lamp His lantern marks a lane across the room and a ghost train runs down it. Leave the lane. Ticket Punch Three marked holes punched round you, one after another. Step off each mark. Departure He boards a phantom carriage and runs straight across the room, leaving ice along the track. Clear his line.

title: The Crucible Golem
text: The Crucible Golem Hidden in sector 5, Cinderheart Foundry. Health 1100. Stages: White Heat → Meltdown. Attack What you see and what to do Pour Its ladle marks a channel across the room, then molten metal runs down it and burns a while. Stay off the channel. Slag Globs of slag lobbed onto marked spots near you; each bursts into a small ring. Leave the marks, then slip the ring. Bellows Its chest grate opens and blows a short cone of sparks. Back off: they die out within reach. Forge Hammer Near you it marks a slam at its fist and sends out a shockwave ring with a gap. Leave the mark, then find the gap. Casting Three molds marked round you fill with metal, then set and fire shards out of each. Leave the molds. Vent At full heat it bursts steam with a gap, then stands cracked open, cooling: hit it hard while it does.

title: The Orrery Seraph
text: The Orrery Seraph Hidden in sector 6, Fracture Observatory. Health 1080. Stages: Precession → Collapse. Attack What you see and what to do Solar Flare Its star throws a ring of light with gaps. Find a gap. Syzygy Its planets slide into a line pointing at you, the line marked through the room; then a beam runs down it. Leave the line. Swelling Orbits Its rings widen across the room and back, the planets sweeping with them. Slip between the planets. Comet A great slow comet thrown at where you are going, shedding debris either side of its path. Step aside early. Lens Its lens marks a beam at one edge of an arc, then sweeps it across. Get behind where it starts or beyond where it ends. Nova Every planet bursts into a ring of shards and re-forms. Keep away from the planets.

title: The Reliquary Mantis
text: The Reliquary Mantis Hidden in sector 7, Verdant Reliquary. Health 1120. Stages: Overgrown → Seed Time. Attack What you see and what to do Sow Seeds flung onto marked spots root and grow into blooms that pulse rings of pollen. Keep off the blooms. Harvest Every open bloom fires a thorn at you at once and withers. Move across their lines. Scythe Marked arcs before it, slashed one after another. Step out of each arc as it comes. Leap It springs straight at you and lands with a ring of thorns. Move off its line, then slip the ring. Spores A slow spiral of spores turning out from it. Circle with the spiral's gaps. Bloomstorm A ring of blooms sown round you at once. Leave the ring before they open.

title: The Tempest Herald
text: The Tempest Herald Hidden in sector 8, Stormbreak Causeway. Health 1140. Stages: Squall Line → The Eye. Attack What you see and what to do Fanfare A trumpet fan of notes that curve with the wind. Move against the curve. Gust A band across the room is marked, then a gale blows down it, pushing you and sweeping shots along. Fly across it or wait it out. Lightning Rods Rods driven into marked spots round you, then bolts leap rod to rod in turn. Stand off the chain. Thunder A ring of thunder with gaps. Find a gap. Squall Rows of slanted rain from the upwind wall, each with a gap. Read the gap in each row. The Eye It draws you toward it while a spiral turns out of it. Fly outward and slip the spiral.

title: The Geode Matriarch
text: The Geode Matriarch Hidden in sector 9, Resonant Quarry. Health 1180. Stages: Fault Line → Hollow Choir. Attack What you see and what to do Raise Crystal spires erupt from marked spots near you and stay. They hurt to touch. Resonance Each spire links to its nearest sister by a marked line, then the line rings. Stand off the lines. Fault A crack runs from it toward you, erupting spot by spot. Step aside from its path. Shatter Every spire bursts into a ring of shards. Keep clear of the spires. Rockfall Stones fall on marked spots round you, spraying as they land. Leave the marks. Chorus Every spire fires a shard at you in turn. Keep moving across their lines.

title: The Umbral Thurifer
text: The Umbral Thurifer Hidden in sector 10, Eclipse Basilica. Health 1220. Stages: Penumbra → Totality. Attack What you see and what to do Swing Its censer whirls once round it on its chain. Keep outside the ring it marks, or pass behind the chain. Double Swing Two censers whirl at once, turning opposite ways. Find the gap as they pass. Incense Slow smoke drifts out and hangs, then bursts into embers. Leave the puffs before they burst. Eclipse A band of shadow crosses the room wall to wall with one lit gap. Stand in the gap as it passes. Totality Two bands cross the room at right angles. Meet both gaps. Litany Candles light in a ring round it and fire at you one after another. Keep moving.

title: The Hedge Warden
text: The Hedge Warden Hidden in sector 1, Briarstorm Cloister. Health 960. Stages: Overgrown → Wildwood. Attack What you see and what to do Hedge Rows of yew grow across the room, each with one gap, and stand a while. Find the gaps and keep off the yew. Snip Its shears open toward you, then close. Leave the space between the blades before they shut. Clippings A fan of leaves, some slow and some quick. Slip through the fan's gaps. Topiary Every standing hedge is clipped at once and sheds leaves from both its sides. Stand between the falling lines. Prune Its shears are flung spinning to the wall and come back, shedding thorns. Keep off their lane.

title: The Compline Owl
text: The Compline Owl Hidden in sector 1, Briarstorm Cloister. Health 980. Stages: Moult → The Long Night. Attack What you see and what to do Gaze A cone of its stare sweeps across the room. Get behind it or out of its reach. Vigil Three cones of its stare turn round it. Move with the gaps between them. Stoop It dives at where you were and lands in a ring of feathers. Move off, then find the ring's gap. Feathers Feathers fly out, stop and hang, then all dart at you at once. Keep moving when they turn. Hoot A ring of sound spreads across the room with one gap. Meet it at the gap.

title: The Sleet Hound
text: The Sleet Hound Hidden in sector 4, Frostveil Transit. Health 1060. Stages: Rime Coat → Whiteout. Attack What you see and what to do Bound It leaps at where you were and lands in a ring of ice. Move off, then find the ring's gap. Frenzy Three bounds one after the other, each landing in a ring. Keep moving. Breath A cone of frost breath leaves rime on the floor that keeps hurting. Leave the cone and keep off the rime. Howl A spiral of sleet turns out of it. Move with the spiral's gaps. Circle It runs a lap round you, dropping shards that then fall inward. Get out of the ring before they fall.

title: The Pointsman
text: The Pointsman Hidden in sector 4, Frostveil Transit. Health 1060. Stages: Black Ice → Last Train. Attack What you see and what to do Lay Rails are laid across the room. Cold rails are harmless. Switch Half the rails go live, each lit along its length first; the other half next time. Stand between the live ones. Derail Every rail goes live but one. Find the rail that stays cold, or the floor between. Signal His lamp swings and three narrow volleys follow you. Keep moving across their line. Trolley A hand-cart runs the length of one rail, throwing sparks off both sides. Keep off its rail.

title: The Furnace Moth
text: The Furnace Moth Hidden in sector 5, Cinderheart Foundry. Health 1100. Stages: Singed → Pyre Wings. Attack What you see and what to do Dust A beat of its wings spreads a slow drift of ash. Weave through the motes. Flutter It zigzags to new places, dropping embers that hang, then fall away from its path. Keep clear of its trail. Kindle Vents near you flare one after another, each throwing a ring of sparks. Leave each marked vent before it flares. Orbit It circles a flare, shedding embers outward. Keep outside its circle, or slip inside. Immolate Its burning wings sweep two cones of flame round it. Move with the gaps.

title: The Lens Grinder
text: The Lens Grinder Hidden in sector 6, Fracture Observatory. Health 1080. Stages: Cracked Lens → Burning Glass. Attack What you see and what to do Mirrors Tall mirrors stand up round the room. They are harmless, but his beams bend off them. Beam A beam at you, its whole path lit first, bending off every mirror it meets. Leave every lit line. Prism The beam splits in three where it first meets a mirror. Watch all three lit lines. Focus Every mirror throws a beam at you at once. Find the space between the lit lines. Shards A fan of glass shards. Slip through the gaps.

title: The Star Cartographer
text: The Star Cartographer Hidden in sector 10, Eclipse Basilica. Health 1080. Stages: Precession → Fallen Sky. Attack What you see and what to do Chart Stars are set on the floor round you. Alone they are harmless. Link The stars are joined into a constellation, each line lit first. Leave the lines before they burn. Wheel The constellation is linked and turns about its middle. Move with the gaps between its lines. Spokes Every star is tied to him by a line of light. Stand between the spokes. Nova Every star bursts into a ring of light. Leave the stars before they burst. Meteor Meteors streak across the room down lit lanes, shedding debris. Keep off the lanes.

title: The Alembic Hydra
text: The Alembic Hydra Hidden in sector 7, Verdant Reliquary. Health 1120. Stages: Boiling Over → Philosopher's Fire. Attack What you see and what to do Acid Globs of acid land on marked spots and leave pools that keep burning. Leave each mark and keep off the pools. Beads Quicksilver beads that bounce off the walls. Watch where they come back from. Jets Steam jets from its three heads sweep round it. Move with the gaps between them. Reflux Every bead still flying rushes back toward it, and the pools spit. Keep off the line between them and it. Overboil Its retort boils over in rings, one after another. Slip through each ring's gaps.

title: The Wrecker
text: The Wrecker Hidden in sector 8, Stormbreak Causeway. Health 1140. Stages: Foul Weather → Lost With All Hands. Attack What you see and what to do Lights False lanterns are set round you. While they burn, his volleys bend toward the nearest. Grapple His hook is flung down a lit lane to the wall, then the chain hurts. Keep off its lane. Barrels Barrels roll out and bounce off the walls. Watch where they come back from. Broadside Ranks of shots march across the room from a wall, each with a gap. Meet each gap. Shipwreck Every lantern bursts into a ring at once. Leave the lanterns before they burst.

title: The Echo Mason
text: The Echo Mason Hidden in sector 9, Resonant Quarry. Health 1180. Stages: Overtone → Shatterpoint. Attack What you see and what to do Chisel A line struck out from him, lit first. Then it rings back, mirrored. Ring A ring of chips with one gap. Its echo turns the gap half round. Tap Spots near you crack. Their echo cracks the mirrored spots. Resonate His last strike sounds again, and echoes twice. Watch for the mirrored lines. Chorus A line, a ring and taps at once, and all of them echo.

title: The Sexton
text: The Sexton Hidden in sector 10, Eclipse Basilica. Health 1220. Stages: Vespers → Requiem. Attack What you see and what to do Dig Graves marked near you open into pits that stay a while. Leave each marked plot and keep off the pits. Shovel His spade swept round him in an arc, marked first. Keep out of its reach. Toll Two rings of shots, the second turned half a step. Slip through each ring's gaps. Risen Every open grave throws bones at you. Move away from the open graves. Procession A row of graves opens one after another across the room, a gap left near you. Stay in the gap.

title: Hazards can hurt enemies too
text: Hazards can hurt enemies too Lure an enemy onto a room hazard's live floor and it takes the sector's reaction: roots hold it in sector 1, the flood swallows enemy shots in 2, a bell stuns in 3, then frost, burn, gravity, spores, lightning, rockfall and shadow through to sector 10. This never works on a boss.

title: The story
text: The story is there if you want it, and it never interrupts a fight. A player who reads nothing still knows what matters: silence the ten bells, and the dead can go. The abbey kept a vigil over its dead for one night each, then lantern-bearers carried each soul out along the moon's silver road to the sea. One night, the vigil was never allowed to end. Ten great bells hold that night in place, and each is kept by a Guardian who refuses to let go. You are the last lantern-bearer. Silence the bells. Let the dead go home.

title: The Wake
text: The Wake The Order of the Silverwake built its abbey down the side of a mountain above a grey sea. Its one rule is the first thing carved in the game: ONE NIGHT FOR EVERY SOUL. We sit with the dead from vespers until the dawn is spoken. Then the bearer comes, lifts the light, and carries it down to the water. We do not hold them longer. Love that holds too long becomes a cage. Each soul's light was tended through its night. At dawn the Archon of the Wake, the Order's highest office, spoke the dawn: the hour bell struck twelve and the Lanternbound flew. These were winged bearers in thruster armour who never set foot on hallowed ground. They carried each light from the Lantern Docks along the causeway and out over the sea on the moon's reflection, the silver wake. The abbey grew into a city to serve that one rule. Then, one night, the dawn was never spoken. See The abbey and its bells for what became of it.

title: Where the story lives
text: Where the story lives Where How to find it Bosses Each speaks an opening line and last words, the first time by default. Settings under Boss dialogue changes that to always or never. Most last words are worth waiting for: the Guardians are mourners, not villains. Vigil Stones 50 carved slabs in the walls. Hover beside one to read it. An unread one keeps a slow glint moving along its lines. Fallen bearers 10 suits of empty armour, hanging where they fell. Hover beside one to read its last words. One of them matters to Sorrel . Four people They wait along the way and speak only if you stop. See NPCs . The rooms Clocks stopped at 11:59, departure boards reading SUSPENDED, ten bell moulds with nine empty. Nothing points these out. The Codex Keeps everything you have heard and read, so you can go back to it. From a fallen bearer, to give you the flavour: Woke at the dock again. The dock remembers us. That is supposed to be a kindness. Bearer Iolo

title: The game, in the story's terms
text: The game, in the story's terms You never need any of this, but the rules of the game are also rules of the world: In the game In the story Lantern Docks The bearers' berths. A bearer's light is tethered to the berth it last rested at, and it wakes there after it falls. A new run The night is rung again. It is always the same night. XP Every creature of the Wake hoards a little stolen light. When it falls, your lantern takes that light in and burns brighter. Hull plates Lanternbound plate, made to carry the dead safely through any weather. Slow-mo The Stillbell, the bearer's small bell, held and never rung. It makes a hush in the abbey's rhythm. Parry The bearer's ward: the turn of the wrist that shielded a light from wind. Melee weapons Tools of the Wake, turned against it. Echo lairs The bells remember. A silenced Guardian is rung back once, weaker in will but not in strength. Boss Arena and Rush Recollections: your memory of a fight. Nothing is freed and nothing is lost there, so no one speaks.

title: NPCs
text: Four people are still awake in the abbey. They are never in a fight and never in your way, there are no quests to accept and no replies to choose. You only have to stop and listen.

title: How talking works
text: How talking works Fly close and a small mark shows over the person's head. Hover beside them for half a second and they speak. One new talk at a time. Each visit plays their first talk you have not heard this run whose conditions are met. Otherwise you get a short idle line. Beating a boss counts for good, in any run, and so does reading a fallen bearer. You can go back in a later run to hear what it opened. Talks start over each run, but a gift is handed over only once. Now and then you will also meet one in a cleared room, with a single line for the road. Why bother? They hand over four of the eleven guns and four of the armours, and how far you follow each one helps choose your ending .

title: Hesk, the Dockwarden
text: Hesk, the Dockwarden By the first dock of sectors 1 and 10 Keeps the berths swept, in case anyone ever sails. He knows the docks, the bells, and more than he says about who you are. Ah. Awake again, bearer? ...No, don't mind me. I'm the dockwarden. I keep the berths swept, in case anyone ever sails. Hear the bells, under everything? Ten of them, ringing the same night over and over. Follow Hesk's story (spoilers) Talks play in this order. One whose condition is not met yet waits until it is. When What happens In sector 1 He tells you about the berths and the ten bells. In sector 1, once you have beaten any Guardian He hands over the Grave Lanterns . In sector 1, once you have beaten the Pale Interceptor "You fly like someone I used to see off." In sector 10, once you have beaten the Last Organ He hands over the Warden Mail . This finishes his story. In sector 1 or 10, after the Eclipse Archon His farewell. He is gone for the rest of that run. What Hesk says on the road Out stretching my legs. The docks get lonely. Mind the dark in here, bearer. Found a lantern hook on the way. Nothing hanging on it. There never is. I walk the old pilgrim route sometimes. My knees remember it better than I do. When there is nothing new to say: "The docks remember you. That's all they're for."

title: Sorrel, a mourner
text: Sorrel, a mourner Moorings of sectors 2, 4 and 7 Came down on the pilgrim train to sit a vigil for her child Wren, a bearer, and never stopped sitting it. Her hands keep weaving as she talks. Have you seen my Wren? A bearer, like you. Small, quick, always humming. I came down on the pilgrim train to sit the vigil, and the night never ended, so I never stopped sitting it. Follow Sorrel's story (spoilers) Talks play in this order. One whose condition is not met yet waits until it is. When What happens Any of her sectors She asks if you have seen Wren. After reading Bearer Wren among the fallen bearers She hands over the Psalm Lance , which still hums. Once you have beaten the Candle Parliament She has lit a candle of her own, and thinks she might be allowed to stop. Once you have beaten the Iron Pilgrim She hands over the Vigil Shroud and leaves. This finishes her story. What Sorrel says on the road Wren came this way once. I can tell. The dust is lighter where someone hummed. I'm only resting. Mourners walk slowly, and the night is long. Do you hum while you fly? Wren did. It drove the others mad. When there is nothing new to say: "I'm still sitting. Someone has to."

title: Ambrel, the Horologist
text: Ambrel, the Horologist Moorings of sectors 3, 6 and 10 Stopped every clock in the abbey at eleven fifty-nine, by his own account. He would like the minute back. Tick. ...Forgive me, habit. There's nothing to tick. Every clock in this abbey says eleven fifty-nine. I should know. I stopped them. Follow Ambrel's story (spoilers) Talks play in this order. One whose condition is not met yet waits until it is. When What happens Any of his sectors He tells you about the minute, hidden in the belfry behind a wall that isn't. Once you have beaten the Borrowed Minute The second hand twitches. This finishes his story, and opens the Horologe Harness . In sector 6 or 10, once you have beaten the Griefwell He hands over the Ossuary Rail . In sector 10, once you have beaten the Last Organ He tells you what waits below. Only before the true ending. After the Eclipse Archon His farewell. He is gone for the rest of that run. What Ambrel says on the road Eleven fifty-nine in here as well. I checked. I always check. A clock in this room started once, for a moment. I came to listen. It stopped. Walls keep time badly. Some of them hardly keep at all. When there is nothing new to say: "Eleven fifty-nine. Still. Always."

title: Corwin, the Lantern-wright
text: Corwin, the Lantern-wright Moorings of sectors 5 and 8 Made every Lanternbound suit. He recognises his rivets on yours, and tells you that one he made first. Hold still. Let me look at that plate. ...These are my rivets. I made every Lanternbound suit, but this one I made first. Follow Corwin's story (spoilers) Talks play in this order. One whose condition is not met yet waits until it is. When What happens Any of his sectors He looks over your plate. In sector 8 He warns you about the First Wing, and hands over the Reliquary Bolt . Once you have beaten the Pale Interceptor His confession. He hands over the Wright-Forged Plate and leaves. This finishes his story. What Corwin says on the road Came out to look for scrap. Your plate's holding, I see. Good rivets. Every room in this place was built by somebody. Hard to remember that, down here. If that left thruster pulls, lean into it. Don't fight it. It never listens. When there is nothing new to say: "Mind the left thruster. It always drifted."
